lead: Today, an unforgettable journey awaits you at VIK Chile, one of South America's most prestigious and innovative wineries. The estate is known for its combination of advanced technology, sustainable winemaking, exceptional terroir and striking contemporary design. VIK wines regularly earn high scores from international critics and rank among Chile's finest.

Transfer from Santiago to the winery and back is by helicopter. The flight takes approximately 40 minutes each way, with panoramic views of valleys, vineyards and the foothills of the Andes. On arrival, you will tour the winery and discover VIK Chile's philosophy, the characteristics of its terroir and the process of producing premium wines. The experience continues with a private tasting of the estate's finest wines and lunch. After the visit, you will fly back to Santiago by helicopter.

The winery lies in the picturesque Millaupo Valley, surrounded by hills and vineyards. This distinctive region has its own microclimate and diverse soils, creating ideal conditions for rich, elegant wines.
